name: Caltech Spring Open 2014

venue.name: [California Institute of Technology](http://www.caltech.edu/)
venue.details: Annenberg Center, room 105.  See website for more details.

information: The cost of registration is $2n + 4, where n is the number of events, if registered before 5/10; otherwise, on-site registration is doubled. $1 will go to the WCA. Caltech students are free. See website for more information, particularly about events and schedule.
